item: ACK1 (TNK2) and ITCH as regulators of WWOX protein stability (Q1 complement): dasatinib and bosutinib as paired ACK1 probes, conditional on WWOX protein being present
reason: Q1 complement (IT10 P2.3): Q1 has no graph route, and a complementary search for regulators of WWOX protein stability yields one usable slice, a mechanism experiment on protein level only. ACK1 over-expression phosphorylates WWOX at Tyr287 followed by polyubiquitination and degradation in LNCaP cells (PMID 16288044, abstract only; full text not obtained); ACK1 shRNA raised WWOX in one HCC line (MHCC-97H), one construct versus scrambled, steady state only (PMID 25738261, full text read 2026-10-30 in IT11 P2.4; it supports ONLY the direction 'knockdown raises WWOX', not the Tyr287 or ubiquitin route). Two catalogued ATP-site inhibitors with measured TNK2 potency (dasatinib, bosutinib; multi-target SRC/ABL kinase inhibitors that share SRC/ABL targets and bind SRC tighter than ACK1: concordance of the two does not identify ACK1 and bosutinib is not an independent chemotype; IT11 P2.4) would be paired probes with the concordance rule (agreement with TNK2 knockdown, a response to one only is off-target); the repeated ChEMBL values (bosutinib 2.7 nM, dasatinib Kd 5.6 and 6.0 nM) are literature values carried between papers, not replicates. CONDITIONAL on WWOX protein being present: it does not apply to the Q230P system as the single datum stands (no band). Nothing predicts function; ITCH raises WWOX half-life but has no compound. COUNTER-EVIDENCE: the ACK1 observation is cancer-cell over-expression (prostate, liver); no Tyr287 change in serum-starved MEFs; MG-132 raised neither wild type nor the P252A or P282A constructs, so a proteasomal route is not shown in the only variant system, whereas chloroquine and NH4Cl restored P252A and chloroquine also prevented its degradation under cycloheximide (a main-text sentence of PMID 41124647), which supports a lysosomal route; ACK1 inhibition sensitised rat cerebellar granule neurons to apoptotic stress (PMID 37263460, abstract); broad kinase inhibitors shift WWOX phospho-forms in cancer cells. The TNK2 missense that abolishes NEDD4 binding in a family with infantile-onset epilepsy (PMID 23686771, abstract) is NOT counter-evidence for lowering ACK1: the abstract gives no kinase-activity direction and it is one family. CNS exposure and tolerability of both agents were not assessed. Not carded: the unit waits for the full text of Mahajan 2005 (R3).
what_would_reopen: the reopenable searches R1 to R7 in triggers.tsv (rows R*_q1_complement): above all R3 (full text of Mahajan 2005 and the HCC paper), R2 (WWOX protein or half-life after ACK1 inhibition or TNK2 loss in a neural or variant-allele cell) and R1 (whether the Q230P protein is made and cleared); a card and a mechanism-probe unit would be created only after R3 or R2
